import random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'.')
import numpy as np
import te.algorithms.formulations.path_based.distributed.worker as W
from numerics import random_problem

rng=random.Random(4242)
worst_fe=0; worst_rel=0; worst_grad=0; worst_x=0
for trial in range(1200):
    provider, caps, demands, owned, bias, mode, rho = random_problem(rng, trial%2==1)
    solver = W.DenseSolver(provider, owned)
    solver.configure(caps,[demands[k] for k in owned],None,bias,mode,rho,owned)
    solver.update()
    if solver.status!='optimal': continue
    p = solver.problem
    x = solver.amounts
    grad = p.derivative(x)
    worst_grad=max(worst_grad, float(np.max(np.abs(grad))) if grad.size else 0.0)
    worst_x = max(worst_x, float(np.max(np.abs(x))) if x.size else 0.0)
    for j,mem in enumerate(p.members):
        mass=float(sum(x[i] for i in mem)); d=float(p.group_demand[j])
        err=abs(mass-d) if mode=='route' else max(0.0, mass-d)
        worst_fe=max(worst_fe,err)
        worst_rel=max(worst_rel, err/max(1.0,d))
    if x.size and np.any(x<0): print('NEGATIVE FLOW', trial)
print('max |sum x - d| (route) / overflow (admit):', worst_fe)
print('max relative:', worst_rel)
print('max |G| seen:', worst_grad, 'max x:', worst_x)
PYEOF
